latest_release.name: v4.3.2
latest_release.body:
> [!WARNING]
> We live in the era of big tech companies buying out OSS project maintainers left and right. Vuetify stays independent as long as community keeps the funds flowing to the OpenCollective. Our team is putting hundreds of hours in to keep the project going:
> - troubleshoot and fix top priority bugs as quickly as possible
> - review incoming PRs
> - deliver new features
> - maintain ecosystem tools
>
> If Vuetify is part of your stack, please consider [sponsoring the project](https://opencollective.com/vuetify) so we can continue delivering updates and fixes.
>
> Every contribution helps us keep Vuetify alive and signals to maintainers that their work matters.
>
> Thank you.

---

### :wrench: Bug Fixes

* **layout:** ignore content height changes without percentage sizes ([2dffc39](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/2dffc39aa4bbb48e4a076eb1e20eb48210b01b23)), closes [#23349](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23349)
* **layout:** disable transitions when item changes location ([cfe1668](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/cfe1668b23c7950c629914d9f7610c48be639b7f)), closes [#20231](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/20231)
* **layout:** don't count unmounted items registered after boot ([#23332](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23332)) ([d913c8d](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/d913c8db3523a51f3eaedb3ca3ab135be235448a))
* **locale:** avoid rebuilding context on every t() call ([3686fef](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/3686fefade6546ce060ab077fa3b940bd7470885))
* **locale:** prevent memory leak during SSR ([#23325](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23325)) ([14af95c](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/14af95cd1f3b2e5a1c40e9e2a6913107ce2490a1))
* **VColorPicker:** keyboard navigation in swatch columns ([#23331](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23331)) ([6e4dfb6](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/6e4dfb650f78e7d7c3901c0306290329ca40f62e)), closes [#20620](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/20620)
* **VDataTable:** hide border of last row with expanded slot ([3adfd7b](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/3adfd7b6e52033f00ec7b2cc6bf9a2db73f2af3d))
* **VFileUpload:** pass id to the file input ([#23330](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23330)) ([e3fcb0f](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/e3fcb0fe92efd5543ad47cdc87944a324164592f)), closes [#23328](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23328)
* **VFileUpload:** apply width props only to the input ([#23327](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23327)) ([542cd68](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/542cd6803f8cd4d27cf144e557f8730ad0f7f6b1)), closes [#23324](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23324)
* **VHotkey:** correct key names and silent separator in accessible label ([#23340](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23340)) ([f28878b](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/f28878bc84ad2bdec78ca2ded136409a28a85c12)), closes [#23335](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23335)
* **VNumberInput,VMaskInput:** keep selection if all typed/pasted characters are rejected ([f706736](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/f7067368a76e1b854803eab7112808c80a96222c)), closes [#23350](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/23350)
* **VDateInput,VTimeInput:** keep selection if all typed/pasted characters are rejected ([38a71e9](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/38a71e99f442eb344cd3484324fef0ea53c00d9d))
* **VOtpInput:** ignore divider width when merged ([21e6fcd](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/21e6fcd7a719d68765145c6b747b805f306494b1))
* **VSelect,VAutocomplete:** do not multiply duplicate items in the model ([17b7887](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/commit/17b78872e1ce4b8e9ba74437ef31a4f22fb00098)), closes [#22878](https://github.com/vuetifyjs/vuetify/issues/22878)
